Coram : M.R. SHAH*, B.V. NAGARATHNA
Appointment – On Compassionate grounds – Ahmednagar Municipal Council was converted to Ahmednagar Mahanagar Palika / Municipal Corporation in 2003 – When the Council was in existence, an industrial dispute was raised by Union – One demand was with respect to employment to employees – In 1981, the Industrial Court directed that the employees in Class- IV category, if they die before their retirement; if they become invalid, or if they retire, their heirs should be given appointment in their place – In 2005 the Industrial Court modified the earlier award
Decision Date : 05-09-2022 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 5944/2022 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
